description: Issue #195 x #196: the ECHO ORDER of all three optional profile fields, pinned with every one of them declared at once. The profile writes them in the reverse of the contract's order (integration_baseline, dispatch_defaults, scope_companions) and the plan carries them as scope_companions -> dispatch_defaults -> integration_baseline. The order is not cosmetic: it is the plan's byte order, every full-text golden measures it, and a runner that spliced a new optional key in between — rather than appending it — would rewrite the bytes of plans whose content did not change. `profile_keys` states the whole ordered field list so the case says what it measures without a golden diff. The declared companion still reaches suspected_files exactly as in case 44, which is the half proving the two newer fields did not disturb L2.
